03/ Dated 11.12.2024 Heard the parties.
Both these bail applications arise out of the same police case and as such, these bail applications are being disposed of by this common order.

The petitioners have been made accused in connection with Adityapur P.S. Case No. 129 of 2024,
corresponding to POCSO Case No.15 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 363, 376,
504, 379, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of POCSO Act and Section 67(B) of I.T. sentences.text: It is alleged that on 27.04.2024, the petitioner Arun Singh lured the victim to accompany him to Dobo Dam, where he raped her.
It appears that two unknown persons came there and took her video and subsequently, the video was made viral.
It is also alleged that the petitioner Nishit Mahato @ Nisit Mahato had made the video viral.
Considering the nature of allegation, I am not inclined to release the petitioners, on bail.
Accordingly, their prayer for bail is hereby rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) BS/-
